# Cross-repo change (core CG-0MUL2G17U003C1N6)

The Main Street loader (`src/tf/mainStreetTfModule.ts`) previously dynamic-imported `/build/tf-synths/main-street-runtime-synth.mjs`. Vite refused to serve it (it lived in `public/`), producing the error overlay 'This file is in /public ... can only be referenced via HTML tags'.

Fix: import the committed module from the core repo (`@core-engine/tf-runtime/main-street-runtime-synth.mjs`) with a static specifier so Vite/Rollup code-splits it into a lazy chunk (Tone.js stays out of the main bundle). Also bump the `core` submodule to the core `dev` commit that carries the module.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `loadMainStreetTfModule()` returns the committed module (12 factories) with no URL fetch; the legacy `__MAIN_STREET_TF_MODULE_URL__` override is inert.
2. Sibling `npm run build` emits `main-street-runtime-synth-*.js` as a separate chunk.
3. Sibling unit suite passes.
4. Pushed to sibling `dev`.
data.title: Load the committed ToneForge runtime synth module via a static-specifier import

data.description:
# GitHub Pages Deploy Fails — Playwright Browsers Missing in CI

## Problem
The `Deploy to GitHub Pages` workflow () fails at the `npm test` step. `storyline-graph-svg.test.ts` uses Playwright's `chromium.launch()` but CI runner does not have Playwright browsers installed.

**Symptom:** Live GitHub Pages site is not updated to v0.1.19.

## Root Cause
- `storyline-graph-svg.test.ts` is in the `unit` vitest project (not `browser`).
- It imports `renderMermaidBatch` which calls `chromium.launch()` — needs Playwright Chromium binary.
- `deploy.yml` does not run `npx playwright install chromium` before `npm test`.
- Pages deploy triggers on push to main, so ship skill's CI check (PR checks) found nothing.

## Fix
Add `npx playwright install --with-deps chromium` before `npm test` in `deploy.yml`.

## Evidence
- CI run: 37913849651 — Test step failed with `browserType.launch: Executable doesn't exist`
- 5283/5284 tests passed; only this one test is affected.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The GitHub Pages deploy workflow installs Playwright Chromium before the test gate, so `storyline-graph-svg.test.ts` can launch Chromium in CI.
2. A regression test in `tests/deploy/deploy-workflow.test.ts` pins the Playwright install step, the `chromium` target, and its ordering before the `Test` step (fails without the fix).
3. The full unit suite (`npm test`) passes in the worktree.
4. The `Deploy to GitHub Pages` workflow succeeds on the next push to `main`, publishing v0.1.19 (verified post-release; the workflow triggers only on `push` to `main`).
data.title: GitHub Pages deploy fails — Playwright browsers missing in CI
